tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and transient-lag signatures favor the coupled siphon-memory ODE. The five pilot horizons cluster between 0.38 and 0.52, around the target of 0.46. The trajectory batch adds time-resolved measurements that can distinguish memory relaxation from sink-modulated forcing before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoints at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and give little leverage to separate memory coupling from fast relaxation.
It accounts for the sink gradient but omits the observed coupled transient lag.
